data.story: hours of practice in a week (x) and the score in a test, out of 10 (y)
data.generator: std::mt19937(seed), hours = round1(0.5 + 3.5u), noise = Box-Muller N(0,1) in double, score = round1(1.5 hours + 2 + 0.6 noise); round1 rounds to one decimal

runs.settle_rule: stop after the first step that changes neither w nor b by more than 1e-5 (at most 1000 steps)
